subject: Out of memory errors when doing SQL query in R

messages.author: 69deb0996449b38c
messages.subject: Out of memory errors when doing SQL query in R
parts:
Hey Group,

I would love some help.

We are running R shiny server in a large instance of EC2 with 7.5 GB memory.

One of our dashboards running a largish query fails with an out of memory error.

Funny thing is that our entire database size is less than 1GB. So I do not know whats going on.

Am guessing R process runs out of memory, but is there a setting I can change.

Pasted below is the error, thanks in advance for your help.

best,
Bhaskar

Error in postgresqlExecStatement(conn, statement, ...) : RS-DBI driver: (could not Retrieve the result : ERROR: out of memory DETAIL: Failed on request of size 32. )
